subject: maths
question:
Study the given bar graph to answer the following question. The bar graph shows the length (in thousand kilometers) of mountains, forests and rivers in different states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ca5efabe58ae2626463564809b195b1409db4db5095d82634ceb633fd8437ce.png] 

The length of mountains in Punjab is what percentage more than the length of rivers in Odisha?
solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ca5efabe58ae2626463564809b195b1409db4db5095d82634ceb633fd8437ce.png] 

**Formula Used: **

Percentage = (mountain length - river length)/(river length)times 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ Length of the mountain in Punjab = 40

⇒ Length of the river in Odisha = 10

So, 

⇒ Percentage = (mountain length - river length)/(river length)times 100= (40-10)/(10)times 100 = 30×10 = 300 

⇒ **Hence, The length of mountains in Punjab percentage more than the length of rivers in Odisha is 300%.**
